Herb or Spice

Red Pepper Flakes

About This Entry

Red pepper flakes add rustic capsaicin heat to pizza, pasta aglio e olio, and Korean gochugaru-adjacent dishes — their flake heat pairs with Sangiovese, Primitivo, and spicy reds.

Wine Pairing Explanation

Primary wine styles

  • zinfandel

Alternative wine styles

  • tempranillo

Why These Wines Work

Zinfandel — Red pepper flake capsicum heat suits Zinfandel fruit in Italian and American chili accent.

Tempranillo — Red pepper flake also pairs with Tempranillo in arrabbiata accent.

Common Culinary Uses
